$comment: The folder for new diagrams: Scala and Rust must give the same answer.
gx-core's GxHome.diagramsDir and the desktop's diagrams_dir_from read
this file. Each case gives the value of $GX_DIAGRAMS_DIR (null: the
variable is not set) and the home directory in `home`. A case has
`expect` (the folder) or `error` (each string must occur in the message).
1. not set, empty, or only spaces: `home`/Documents/Graph Explorer
2. an absolute value replaces the folder. The spaces at the two ends go,
and the dot segments resolve. A `..` at the root stays at the root.
3. a relative value is refused, as a relative GX_HOME is refused: gx and
the desktop do not share a working directory.
The paths are POSIX paths. On Windows, `/tmp/x` is not absolute, so the
two test suites skip this file there.

diagramsDir.name: an absolute value replaces the folder
the spaces at the two ends go
a .. at the root stays at the root
a space inside the name stays
a nested relative value is refused
